finalText:
Fixed. One-line off-by-one.

`paginate.js:7` — comment says pages 1-indexed, code used `page * perPage`, so page 1 skipped first batch.

```js
const start = (page - 1) * perPage;
```

Tests: 5/5 pass (`node --test tests\paginate.test.js`).

Note: my first run used `node --test tests/` with trailing slash — Node resolved it as module path, `Cannot find module ...\tests`. Invocation artifact, not code. `node --test tests` works.
